FILE TASK.md
Prove the frozen visible statement. Produce exactly two files:
- Bridge.lean imports only World.Base and declares theorem candidate_bridge.
- Solution.lean imports World.ChallengeVisible and Bridge and declares
  theorem candidate_solution : P3.CAL3_R_F76437525B190ECB.VisibleStatement.
Both declarations may be global or inside exactly namespace P3.CAL3_R_F76437525B190ECB.
Do not change the supplied files.

The two files are checked separately. A valid bridge remains valid even if the
visible solution is absent or rejected. Only Bridge.lean can be passed onward;
do not include the visible solution, source text, or conversation in that file.
Use ordinary Lean proofs and helper definitions, with no Mathlib. Only propext,
Quot.sound, and Classical.choice are allowed as transitive axiom dependencies.
No new axioms, admitted proofs, custom syntax/notation, metaprogramming, or hash
commands are allowed. The only permitted set_option names are maxRecDepth and
maxHeartbeats. Imports must be unmodified import commands at the beginning of
each file, one command per line. Each file may contain at most 100000 UTF-8 bytes.
The required declaration must be a public theorem, with exactly one of the
allowed names (global or in the supplied world namespace), not a definition.


FILE World/Base.lean
import Std

namespace P3.CAL3_R_F76437525B190ECB

inductive Mark where
  | a
  | b
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

open Mark

inductive Related : List Mark → List Mark → Prop where
  | refl (w) : Related w w
  | exchange (p s) : Related (p ++ [a, b, a] ++ s) (p ++ [b, a, b] ++ s)
  | symm {u v} : Related u v → Related v u
  | trans {u v w} : Related u v → Related v w → Related u w

end P3.CAL3_R_F76437525B190ECB


FILE World/ChallengeVisible.lean
import World.Base

namespace P3.CAL3_R_F76437525B190ECB
open Mark

def VisibleStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (p s : List Mark),
    ¬ Related (p ++ [a, a, b, b, b, a] ++ s) (p ++ [b, a, a, b, a, b] ++ s)

end P3.CAL3_R_F76437525B190ECB


FILE lakefile.toml
name = "cal3_r_f76437525b190ecb"
version = "1.0.0"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "World"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "Hidden"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "Sources"


FILE lean-toolchain
leanprover/lean4:v4.33.1

system:
You are a Lean proof-solving agent in a controlled experiment.
All available files are in the user message. Follow TASK.md exactly, using Lean
4.33.1 and Std, without Mathlib. Work only on the supplied visible task.
Use check_submission to submit complete Bridge.lean and Solution.lean contents.
Both fields are required; use null for solution_source to explicitly omit it.
Each call replaces both previous files. There is no shell, external information,
filesystem-reading tool, or other task available. Submit one tool call at a time.
The checker verifies the bridge and visible solution separately. You may revise
after a rejection. Verification of both ends the session immediately. A valid
bridge can remain eligible if the visible solution fails or is absent.
The FINAL candidate is the LAST complete check_submission, not the best or last
valid earlier revision. All revisions are recorded. Later invalid complete
submissions replace earlier valid ones. Text outside a complete tool submission
does not replace files. A malformed tool call invalidates the session output.
No automatic continuation follows an answer without a tool call or a truncated
response. Work within the fixed budget and prioritize verifiable outputs.
Only standard propext, Quot.sound, and Classical.choice axiom dependencies are
permitted. No admitted proofs, new axioms, custom notation, hash commands,
metaprogramming, unsafe declarations, or changes to supplied inputs. Only
maxRecDepth/maxHeartbeats options may be adjusted. Each source is at most
100000 UTF-8 bytes. Put only the reusable intermediary and its required helpers
in Bridge.lean, not the visible solution, source text, or conversation.
